title: "A very tough place to win a series" | Pat Cummins post match press conference | SL vs AUS, 2nd Test
quote_text:
Dinesh Chandimal’s double century and bowling heroics by debutant Prabhat Jayasuriya led Sri Lanka to a series-levelling win over Australia on Monday in a second Test 

Australia Test skipper Pat Cummins said their tour to Pakistan, where they won the Test series 1-0, and then in Sri Lanka gave them a new perspective.

“We spent two years basically stuck at home during Covid and our last two tours had been to Pakistan where we hadn’t toured for 20-odd years, and now Sri Lanka in the middle of a country in crisis,” Cummins told reporters.

“We’ve got protests round the ground, it really hits home how lucky we are to be travelling the world but also in some ways it’s more than just being here to play cricket, you can see the impact it can have.”
